summary: ResumeStudio is an offline-first career workspace. Résumés, applications, cover letters, contacts, offers, interview history, and career evidence are stored on your device by default. Connected processing happens only when you choose a feature that requires it.
features: Structured editing, import, ATS readiness, Recruiter Scan, 131 résumé templates, Layout Studio, searchable PDF and editable DOCX export.
Capture job adverts, track applications, connect documents and contacts, schedule interviews, compare offers, and act on a focused Today queue.
On-device assistance handles suitable lightweight work. Higher-quality connected AI powers complex tailoring, interview plans, cover letters, and Career Coach workflows.
privacyBullets: Drafts, applications, contacts, offers, and voice recordings are stored on device first.
On-device OCR reads selected screenshots and scanned job documents locally.
AI requests are explicit, redacted, App Check protected, and returned for review.
No advertising, data sale, or cross-app tracking.
Local, iCloud, hosted, and account data have separate export and deletion controls.

privacySections.title: Data stored on your device
paragraphs: ResumeStudio stores your résumé documents and photos, versions, layouts, cover letters, applications, contacts, offers, interview work, selected source files, AI results, settings, processing history, and the last verified StoreKit entitlement needed for secure offline access.
Voice-practice recordings remain local. When you request AI feedback, the transcript and delivery measurements may be sent, but not the raw recording.

privacySections.title: On-device intelligence and OCR
paragraphs: Selected screenshots, images, and scanned documents can be read with Apple Vision on your device. On supported Apple Intelligence devices, suitable lightweight writing and extraction tasks may use Apple’s on-device Foundation Models framework. Content handled entirely on device is not sent to ResumeStudio, Firebase, or OpenAI.

Free users receive on-device assistance first when it is available. Connected fallback is off by default and can be enabled explicitly; it may use the credits displayed for the action. Go and Pro users receive the higher-quality connected AI service first, with on-device assistance used only as a private fallback for eligible temporary failures.

privacySections.title: Connected AI processing
paragraphs: Connected AI runs only after you select an AI action. Requests pass through ResumeStudio’s Firebase backend to OpenAI. The backend uses Firebase App Check, fixed supported actions, usage limits, structured responses, and requests that OpenAI does not store the response for later retrieval.

Writing requests exclude names, phone numbers, email addresses, references, profile photographs, attached source files, interview links, interviewer names, and private source URLs. The minimum relevant redacted résumé or career evidence is sent for the selected task. You can pause AI and exclude Evidence Vault items in Privacy Centre.

privacySections.title: Privacy-safe product measurement
paragraphs: Anonymous product insights are off by default. If you opt in, the app sends only allow-listed coarse event names, plan tier, AI route, app version, and a coarse onboarding goal. Events never include résumé text, identity, contact details, job descriptions, company names, URLs, document contents, advertising identifiers, or a persistent analytics identifier. The server stores aggregate daily counts, not a user activity timeline, and automatically deletes those aggregate documents after 90 days.

privacySections.title: iCloud, accounts, and hosted features
paragraphs: If you enable document sync, ResumeStudio stores a workspace archive in your private iCloud container under your Apple Account. Firebase may store authentication records, saved AI results, AI-credit usage, referral records, entitlement verification, public CV-page metadata, trackable-link metadata, and hosted Review Room content needed to provide those features.

Publishing a CV page, trackable résumé link, or Review Room uploads the exact PDF you select, which may contain personal information you placed in that PDF. Links can be withdrawn, revoked, or deleted by their owner.

privacySections.title: Purchases
paragraphs: Apple processes purchases and payment details. ResumeStudio receives signed transaction information such as product identifier, status, purchase date, and expiration date to unlock access and enforce allowances. ResumeStudio does not receive card or bank details.

privacySections.title: Data sharing and tracking
paragraphs: ResumeStudio does not sell personal data, show third-party advertising, or track you across other companies’ apps and websites. Service providers receive data only to provide authentication, cloud functions, AI processing, purchase verification, optional iCloud sync, or explicitly published hosted features.

privacySections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: On-device data remains until you delete it or remove the app. iCloud data remains until you erase the archive. Saved AI work remains in Firebase until you delete it or your account. Hosted links end on expiry, revocation, withdrawal, or deletion. Optional aggregate product metrics expire automatically after 90 days.
Settings lets you separately delete the server account, on-device workspace, iCloud archive, AI history, and career intelligence. Deleting an account does not cancel an App Store subscription.

privacySections.title: Children, changes, and contact
paragraphs: ResumeStudio is not directed to children under 13. This policy will be updated before material processing changes take effect.
For privacy or deletion questions, email currenttech.co.za@gmail.com.

Cross-app tracking data

Background location
Your address book

dataCards.title: Stored on device
items: Résumés, photos, layouts, versions, and exports
Applications, contacts, offers, and interview history
Career evidence, local source files, and AI results
Voice recordings and transcripts
Preferences and secure offline entitlement state

dataCards.title: Processed only when requested
items: Apple Vision reads selected screenshots or scans locally.
Apple Foundation Models may process eligible lightweight tasks locally.
OpenAI receives a redacted, task-specific request through Firebase for connected AI.
Apple receives purchase requests and returns entitlement status.
iCloud receives the workspace archive only when sync is enabled.

dataCards.title: Hosted by explicit action
items: Review Rooms upload a selected PDF and reviewer metadata.
Trackable links upload a selected PDF and privacy-safe engagement totals.
Public CV pages upload the selected résumé and chosen public profile fields.
All hosted surfaces can be withdrawn or deleted.

measurement: Anonymous product insights are off by default. When you opt in, only allow-listed event names, plan tier, AI route, app version, and a coarse onboarding goal are sent for aggregate product improvement. Résumé content, identity, company names, job descriptions, URLs, advertising identifiers, and persistent analytics IDs are prohibited. Aggregate daily documents expire after 90 days.
supportIntro: Get help with documents, accounts, purchases, AI credits, iCloud sync, public CV pages, trackable links, and Review Rooms.
supportDiagnostic: Include your device model, iOS version, ResumeStudio version and build number, the feature you were using, the exact steps, and the error shown. Attach a screenshot only after checking it contains no résumé or job-search data. Never send passwords, access codes, payment-card details, or a résumé unless you deliberately choose to share it for support.

supportCards.title: Account and data
supportCards.body: Use Settings → Account and backup to reset a password or separately delete server, local, and iCloud data. Account deletion does not cancel an App Store subscription.

supportCards.title: Plans and purchases
supportCards.body: Use Settings → Plans and purchases to restore purchases. Manage or cancel subscriptions through your Apple Account subscription settings.

supportCards.title: Offline access
supportCards.body: Editing, preview, export, applications, saved interview work, OCR, and eligible on-device AI remain available offline. Connected AI and hosted features require a connection.

supportCards.title: Privacy and hosted links
supportCards.body: Privacy Centre controls AI and history. CV pages, résumé links, and Review Rooms can be withdrawn, revoked, or deleted from their management screens.
